    TYPE force_y[nAtoms],
    TYPE force_z[nAtoms],
    TYPE position_x[nAtoms],
    TYPE position_y[nAtoms],
    TYPE position_z[nAtoms],
    int32_t NL[nAtoms * maxNeighbors]) {

    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=force_x
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=force_y
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=force_z
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=position_x
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=position_y
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=position_z
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=NL

    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=force_x bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=force_y bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=force_z bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=position_x bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=position_y bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=position_z bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=NL bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=nAtoms bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=return bundle=control

    #pragma HLS DATAFLOW

    Loop_i:
    for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++) {
        #pragma HLS LOOP_TRIPCOUNT min=256 max=256
        Loop_j:
        for (int j_idx = 0; j_idx < maxNeighbors; j_idx++) {
            #pragma HLS LOOP_TRIPCOUNT min=16 max=16
            int j = NL[i * maxNeighbors + j_idx];
            if (j >= nAtoms) continue; // sanity check, but perhaps not needed

            // Compute distance
            TYPE dx = position_x[i] - position_x[j];
            TYPE dy = position_y[i] - position_y[j];
            TYPE dz = position_z[i] - position_z[j];

            TYPE r2 = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz;
            if (r2 == 0.0) continue; // Avoid division by zero

            TYPE r2_inv = 1.0 / r2;
            TYPE r6_inv = r2_inv * r2_inv * r2_inv;
            TYPE r12_inv = r6_inv * r6_inv;

            TYPE f_force = (12.0 * lj1 * r12_inv - 6.0 * lj2 * r6_inv ) * r2_inv;

            TYPE fx = f_force * dx;
            TYPE fy = f_force * dy;
            TYPE fz = f_force * dz;

            // Update forces on atoms i and j
            force_x[i] += fx;
            force_y[i] += fy;
            force_z[i] += fz;

            force_x[j] -= fx;
            force_y[j] -= fy;
            force_z[j] -= fz;
        }
    }
}

void md_kernel(
    TYPE force_x[nAtoms],
    TYPE force_y[nAtoms],
    TYPE force_z[nAtoms],
    TYPE position_x[nAtoms],
    TYPE position_y[nAtoms],
    TYPE position_z[nAtoms],
    int32_t NL[nAtoms * maxNeighbors]) {

    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=force_y
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=force_z
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=position_x
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=position_y
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=position_z
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=ap_none port=NL

    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=force_x bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=force_y bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=force_z bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=position_x bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=position_y bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=position_z bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=NL bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=nAtoms bundle=control
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE mode=s_axilite port=return bundle=control

    #pragma HLS DATAFLOW

    Loop_i:
    for (int i = 0; i < nAtoms; i++) {
        #pragma HLS LOOP_TRIPCOUNT min=256 max=256
        Loop_j:
        for (int j_idx = 0; j_idx < maxNeighbors; j_idx++) {

            int j = NL[i * maxNeighbors + j_idx];

            TYPE dy = position_y[i] - position_y[j];
            TYPE dz = position_z[i] - position_z[j];

            TYPE r2 = dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz;
            if (r2 == 0.0) continue; // Avoid division by zero

            TYPE r2_inv = 1.0 / r2;
            TYPE r6_inv = r2_inv * r2_inv * r2_inv;
            TYPE r12_inv = r6_inv * r6_inv;

            TYPE f_force = (12.0 * lj1 * r12_inv - 6.0 * lj2 * r6_inv ) * r2_inv;

            TYPE fx = f_force * dx;
            TYPE fy = f_force * dy;
            TYPE fz = f_force * dz;

            force_y[i] += fy;
            force_z[i] += fz;

            force_x[j] -= fx;
            force_y[j] -= fy;
            force_z[j] -= fz;
        }
    }
